title: 00451 - P11A7/004519
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Possible loss of power, due to AVS (Audi Valve Lift System) default position affecting lower (1000~3100 RPM) torque curve
All non affected actuators are switched to the Large Valve Lift position.
Fault code entry without EPC or Kontrol edin:  Engine lights due to no deterioration of Exhaust Emissions
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or connections (short circuit?)
Voltage supply failure to the Cam Adjustment Actuators
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  for battery voltage at Cam Adjustment Actuators
Kontrol edin:  Engine Kontrol Modülü with [Output tests]
technicalNotes:
See the Ross-Tech forum post: - Case Study: P11A7 00 - Audi Valve Lift System - E888 engines
This Fault code is for the F369-Control element (4) for camshaft adjustment, Cylinder [2]
AVS system function when coolant temperature is above 14°F (–10°C).
Maximum of 3.0 amperes for each Cam Adjustment Actuator
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
